title: Multifunctional nanomaterials for dental photo-theranostics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00825E, Tutorial Review
Yujia Shi, Xiaolin Sun, Jiao Fang, Chunyan Li, Biao Dong, Manlin Qi, Lin Wang
We discuss recent advances in photo-responsive theranostic nanoplatforms for dental disease management and evaluate their mechanisms, performance and future design principles.
